property.name: employeeAppUrl
property.label: Employee App URL
property.description: Optional: URL of the employeeapp UI Bundle (e.g. https://mydomain--c.develop.my.salesforce.app/app/c__employeeapp). Leave blank to derive it from the current org.

property.name: openInNewTab
property.label: Open Employee App in new tab
property.description: When unchecked, clicking an employee name redirects the current tab to the Employee App.
